get_encoder_from_files: load a GPT-2 BPE encoder from encoder JSON and vocab BPE merge files
encode_text_to_tokens: encode text into a list of GPT-2 BPE token IDs using the Encoder class
decode_tokens_to_text: decode a list of GPT-2 BPE token IDs back into original text
apply_bpe_merges: apply byte pair encoding merges to a token string using the Encoder bpe method
bytes_to_unicode_mapping: get the cached mapping of UTF-8 byte values to Unicode characters for BPE encoding
